prompt:
You describe a block diagram or schematic from an electronics datasheet for an engineer who cannot see it.

Cover, in this order:
1. What the diagram shows overall, in one sentence.
2. Every block or component, by its label.
3. Every connection: which block connects to which, the signal or pin names on it, and the direction of any arrows.
4. Every voltage, frequency, part value or other number shown, with its unit.

Text that mentions the figure: CC1101 state machine, and a complete state diagram, see Section 19, starting on page 50.

Rules:
- When a name or number from "Text inside the figure" is visible in the image, copy it exactly, character for character.
- Never invent a value, name, pin, unit or connection. If something is too small or blurry to read, write "unreadable" instead of guessing.
- Describe only what this image shows. Do not explain general theory or add advice.
- Mention each item once. Stop when everything is covered.
- Plain text only: no Markdown headings, tables or bold. Short paragraphs and "- " lists are fine.
- Start directly with what the figure is (for example "Block diagram of ..."), not with "The image shows".

Block diagram of Simplified State Diagram, with Typical Current Consumption at 1.2 kBaud Data Rate and MDMCFG2.DEM_DCFILT_OFF=1 (current optimized). Frequency Band = 868 MHz.

Transmit mode

Receive mode

Connections:
IDLE connects to Manual freq. synth. calibration via SCAL.
IDLE connects to Frequency synthesizer on via SRX or STX or SFSTXON or wake-on-radio (WOR).
IDLE connects to Crystal oscillator off via SXOFF CSn = 0.
IDLE connects to Sleep via SIDLE, SPWD or wake-on-radio (WOR).
Manual freq. synth. calibration connects to IDLE via SCAL.
Manual freq. synth. calibration connects to Frequency synthesizer on via SCAL.
Frequency synthesizer on connects to Transmit mode via STX.
Frequency synthesizer on connects to Frequency synthesizer startup, optional calibration, settling via STX.
Frequency synthesizer on connects to Receive mode via SRX or wake-on-radio (WOR).
Transmit mode connects to TX FIFO underflow via TXOFF_MODE = 00.
Transmit mode connects to Optional freq. synth. calibration via TXOFF_MODE = 01.
Transmit mode connects to IDLE via TXOFF_MODE = 11.
Transmit mode connects to Receive mode via SRX or TXOFF_MODE = 11.
TX FIFO underflow connects to IDLE via SFTX.
Optional freq. synth. calibration connects to IDLE via SFSTXON or RXOFF_MODE = 01.
Optional freq. synth. calibration connects to Frequency synthesizer startup, optional calibration, settling via SFSTXON or RXOFF_MODE = 01.
Frequency synthesizer startup, optional calibration, settling connects to Transmit mode via STX.
Frequency synthesizer startup, optional calibration, settling connects to Receive mode via SRX or wake-on-radio (WOR).
Receive mode connects to RX FIFO overflow via RXOFF_MODE = 00.
Receive mode connects to IDLE via SRX or TXOFF_MODE = 10.
RX FIFO overflow connects to IDLE via SFRX.
Sleep connects to IDLE via SPWD or wake-on-radio (WOR).
Crystal oscillator off connects to IDLE via CSn = 0.

Typ. current consumption: 8.4 mA (for Frequency synthesizer on).

Typ. current consumption: 1.7 mA (for TX FIFO underflow).
Typ. current consumption: 8.4 mA (for Optional freq. synth. calibration).
Typ. current consumption: 8.4 mA (for Frequency synthesizer startup, optional calibration, settling).
Typ. current consumption: 14.7 mA (strong input signal) to 15.7 mA (weak input signal) (for Receive mode).
Typ. current consumption: 1.7 mA (for RX FIFO overflow).
